title: Read a raw storage slot from any Ethereum contract via eth_getStorageAt
description: Read a raw storage slot from any Ethereum contract via eth_getStorageAt

_signals.x_guidance: OneSource exposes a curated catalog of live Ethereum RPC calls across Ethereum mainnet and the Sepolia testnet (select via the `network` parameter). Every /api/chain/* endpoint is a thin wrapper around a single eth_* RPC method (eth_getBalance, eth_call, eth_getLogs, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getBlockByNumber, etc.) against a OneSource-operated Ethereum node - there is no cached or indexed data here; every response is freshly fetched. Pay via x402 (USDC on Base): per-call with the `exact` scheme or batch/session with the `x402-batch` scheme. Pay via MPP on Tempo: per-call charges accept pathUSD or USDC.e; session-mode payments are USDC.e-only (`tempo.session`). Tempo CLI managed wallets (`tempo request`) sign with USDC.e by default; mpp-go and direct-keypair clients can pay in either currency. See /openapi.json for the full operation schema and per-endpoint pricing.
